_doc: ADR 0216b. Excerpt of TED (Tenders Electronic Daily, Publications Office of the EU) notices of the City of Bialystok for the delivery and installation of LED street luminaires, from the public TED Search API v3 (POST https://api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search, query FT~"opraw" AND buyer-city="Bialystok" AND publication-date>=20220101), fetched 2026-11-15. cn-standard = contract notice, can-standard = contract award notice (contract concluded). Contractor and product names omitted. The 2023 notices of Andersa / 1000-lecia / Maczka (TED 658997-2023, platform notice 93688) are cited from research/night-lamps-s21 (K69 section 4). A notice proves the tender / contract scope by street name, not the installation date or the street section: installed state 2026 UNVERIFIED.
